scope: Offline replay of a previously generated Gemini recording, not a live API call or latency benchmark. Listening quality is not scored.

source.preprocessing: One shared pass: PCM16 /32767, channel mean if needed, soxr HQ to 16000 Hz if needed, round*32767 and clip to PCM16. Both paths then use identical input16k.wav bytes and official PCM16 /32767 normalization.

speaker_cache.extraction: Verified official infer_e2e speaker cache; not legacy runtime embedding

rng.policy: Identical frozen initial CPU state; official full sequence versus prefix absolute-position draws

model.shared_objects: Both paths use Engine.template.asr and vocoder; DiT implementations differ but load the same pinned weights

whole.method: Unmodified infer_e2e.extract_bn + infer_e2e.vc_inference; full-utterance feature interpolation and whole-mel Vocos decode

stream.method: Engine.new_runner(prefix_quality); only arrived PCM supplied in 160 ms packets, then finish; no sleeps or API transport

prefix_policy.noise: absolute-position continuous CPU RNG, frozen official CLI state
prefix_policy.tail: real samples only; no ASR padding; final partial VC block retained
prefix_policy.quality_status: one experimental sample accepted; live conversation needs listening

vocoder_policy.startup_note: 32 future frames; 12-frame model packets round first emission to 48 received frames. This is not total call latency.

measurement_notes: 160 ms is a replay packet size, not response delay. Input required before first output measures buffering only.
Compute excludes model loading, source preparation, API generation, network and audio playback. Whole runs first; no benchmark warmup or repetition.
Both are fixed prerecorded Schedar inputs; changing the page's live source voice does not regenerate these files.

This compares the actual official whole path with the actual prefix stream path under shared source, reference, weights and initial RNG. Their DiT implementations also differ; no single-cause attribution or subjective quality, production throughput or full-duplex claim is made.
Official full-file fbank/ASR omits incomplete end frames; prefix finish uses real frames only and does not add ASR padding.
